'''''Warrior's Honor''''' was a painting available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Created by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Dreyba]], the painting depicted a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] looking off to stage left, wearing [[Color/Legends|black]] pants, a silver belt, a green [[Poncho/Legends|poncho]], and a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] over his left shoulder. The [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]] of a creature appeared in the foreground of the image. The style and appearance of ''Warrior's Honor'' was similar to that of ''[[Fighter's Courage]]'', which was also created by Dreyba.

==Behind the scenes==
''Warrior's Honor'' is a painting that appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It can be used in the player's home as decoration. The painting was added to the game in [[2010]] as part of the "rare loot system," which allows players to obtain exceedingly rare items as loot from any enemy in the game.
